name: ZigZag Image Captcha for Contact Form 7
author: Suraj Kumar Sinha

sections.description:
ZigZag Image Captcha for Contact Form 7 adds a powerful, image-based captcha to Contact Form 7.

This plugin generates a secure zig-zag distorted image captcha with background noise, dots, lines, and randomized angles to prevent automated bots.

It works 100% with AJAX, supports auto-refresh, expiration timer, session validation, and displays CF7 native error messages.

🔒 Features

  • Secure zig-zag distorted captcha
  • Random characters with noise, distortion, and angled letters
  • Auto image refresh with single click
  • Session-based secure validation
  • Expiration timer with auto-regeneration
  • Native CF7 error messages (not custom overrides)
  • Works with both AJAX and non-AJAX submissions
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • No external API required
  • Fully responsive

🛠 How to Use

Add this shortcode inside any Contact Form 7 form:[imagecaptcha* cf7_image_captcha]
